sheets.name: run_1
sheets.action: running (her move loop): a light, quick run, the Relic Cannon carried slanting across her body, the hood's sash and the locs flying, the LEGS CHANGING OVER
sheets.weapons: THE RELIC CANNON goes where the pale figure has it, frame by frame (image 3 shows it in colour): ONE cannon, WHOLE and STRAIGHT, as large as in image 1 - the gold claw grip, the gold ring with its dark round eye, the pale ice-blue crystal blade, the wine-red wing panel with its gold ribs - in her hands, on her shoulder, levelled forward, swung up or pointed down as the pale figure holds it; the blade end is the muzzle, the gold claw is the grip; never bent, cut, shortened or a second cannon. Only the cannon: no beam, no muzzle flash, no black mist, no souls.
sheets.legs: Frame 1: STRIDE: the NEAR leg (the lighter one) reaching forward (image right), the FAR leg behind pushing off. Frame 2: the near foot landing under her, the far leg lifting off behind. The two legs TAKE TURNS: in frames 1-4 the NEAR leg (the lighter one) leads, in frames 5-8 the FAR leg (the darker one) - frames 1 and 5 must look different: the other leg in front. Follow the pale figure's LEGS exactly; never the same leg in front in every frame (Talon's first run did that: 「走路没有换腿」).
